title: Pyramid
summary: Credits vary for Pyramid; he wrote it noodling on trombone and Duke arranged it.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: How about 'Pyramid?' That one is listed -- one time it's listed by Tizol and Ellington and then the next time it is Tizol, Ellington and Mills.

Anything having to do with lyrics, Mills is gonna get on there. But who did it, I don't know. Mills had plenty of publishers to do the things. I guess he gave them some money and they would put his name on them.
How did you happen to write 'Pyramid?'

I used to be sometimes in the theatre -- we were playing theatres, and in the dressing room, I'd just start playing the trombone, and trying to see if I could get some kind of a melody, and that's the way I did it.
Do you remember where you were or what city?
Well, I don't know about where I started
it, I don't know where "Pyramid" started, but I usually played at home -- when I was practicing, I'd be playing something, and if I liked it, I'd put it down on paper.
And then play it for Duke, right?
Yeah, and Duke would arrange it and put it on a record.
